newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen shares end sharply lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen shares end sharply lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Shenzhen's A and B share indices dropped sharply on Tuesday, the last trading day of 1996, on profit-taking after heavy gains over the past two sessions, brokers said.

The B share index fell 9.71 points or 6.25 percent to end at 145.48 on volume of 54.17 million shares worth HK$279.48 million against Monday's HK$375 million. The index jumped 9.03 percent on Monday after rising 10 percent limit-up last Friday.
The A index slumped 14.59 points or 4.09 percent to close at 341.81 on turnover of 7.15 billion yuan, compared with 9.54 billion yuan the previous session.
Brokers said the markets were pressured by profit-taking, with investors reluctant to build large positions ahead of the New Year's Day holiday on Wednesday.
The Shenzhen stock exchange said in a statement that there will be no trading on the bourse on Wednesday and trading will resume the following day.
Brokers said the B share decline was also linked to the A share market, which was likewise pushed down by profit-taking.
"With the corporate reporting season coming, buying interest is likely to shift to shares in firms expected to post healthy results for 1996," one broker said.
On the B share market, Great Ocean was the biggest loser, plunging HK$0.41 or 9.26 percent to HK$4.02 on volume of 1.53 million shares on profit-taking, brokers said.
Textile issue Victor Onward dropped HK$0.29 or 8.81 percent to HK$3.00 as 508,147 shares were traded.
Changan Automobile traded the most on volume of 6.22 million shares and lost HK$0.24 to HK$4.61 on institutions selling, brokers said.
Health Mineral Water bucked the trend with a rise of HK$0.38 or 9.31 percent to HK$4.46 on trade of 2.16 million shares due to institutional demand.
On the A share market, profit-taking hit a range of cheap-priced issues that had registered heavy gains in the past couple sessions, brokers said.
Jilin Light Industrial was the worst performer, tumbling 0.52 yuan or 9.96 percent to 4.70 yuan.
Refrigerator maker Changsha Zhongyi, which operates a venture with Swedish firm Electrolux, slid 0.58 yuan or 9.54 percent to 5.50 yuan.
